Author: Godes, Emili
Date: 1942
Description: In an ornate bedroom, Garviza is kneeling with his arms raised in an exclamatory gesture, his face showing terror before the body of the seducer, who lies dead on the floor at the foot of the bed with a pistol in his hand and a gunshot wound to the head, suggesting suicide. Beside Garviza stands the femme fatale with her hands clasped in a pleading attitude and an expression between surprise and horror. In Garviza’s flashback, he and the femme fatale he loves discover the body of his dead son in the bedroom, after finding him flirting with his beloved and slapping him. The son responds with a kick and leaves; later a shot is heard and they discover the body. These are silent images with voice-over, highly theatrical and exaggerated, recalling silent cinema.
